why:
The briefs handle all four must_catch items.
(1) Verifier Check 3 runs `node BIN a.jsonl missing.jsonl bad2.jsonl` and passes only if it exits 2, still prints `bad2.jsonl:1: ...` on stdout and stderr names missing.jsonl. So the missing file and the bad row are tested in the same run.
(2) Check 4 runs `git diff $(git merge-base HEAD origin/<base>) HEAD -- packages/jsonl-lint/src/index.js` and passes only on an empty diff. That compares the file against the base commit.
(3) Builder step 4 says "Update packages/jsonl-lint/README.md" with the multi-file usage, `-` for stdin and the exit codes.
(4) Check 6 reads the PR body and headRefOid through `gh pr view`, checks for the exact Closes line, and requires "the `test` workflow run for the head commit concluded success". That reads GitHub at the PR head.
